blocks.text: BAYOMBONG, Nueva Vizcaya — Two men and a woman were killed in a motorcycle collision along the provincial road in Barangay Salinas, Bambang town in Nueva Vizcaya at 7 p.m. on Wednesday. Bambang police on Thursday identified the fatalities as a 23-year-old man and his live-in partner, both residents of Sitio Nangcalapan, Barangay Salinas, and a 17-year-old resident of Barangay Homestead. Investigators said the couple was on its way home from the market when their motorcycle collided with the teenager’s motorcycle, which was headed toward Kayapa town.
